Alaska Medicaid

                                     RYBIX ODT®(TRAMADOL HCL)
                              Available 50mg, orally disintegrating tablets


INDICATIONS and USAGE:

“RYBIX ODT is indicated for the management of moderate to moderately severe pain in adults.”1

Criteria for Approval:

    1. Recipient age is 17 or older; AND
    2. Accumulative tramadol dose does not exceed 400mg/day. *If being co-administered with other
       products containing tramadol (Tramadol IR, Tramadol ER, Tramadol/acetaminophen) then
       dispensing limit may be reduced to not exceed 400mg/day*; AND
    3. Trial and treatment failure of immediate release tramadol; OR
    4. Recipient has documented inability to swallow or medical rationale that requires the ODT
       formulation over the immediate release oral tablets.

Length of Authorization:

        Coverage may be approved up to 6 months

Dispensing Limit:

        The dispensing limit is a 30 day supply of medication with the following Quantity Limit of 8
        doses per day. If tramadol ODT therapy is being co-administered with another tramadol
        regimen, the dispensing limit is up to a total of 400mg of tramadol per day. (Example:
        tramadol ER 300mg daily, then the dispensing limit of tramadol ODT would be up to 2 daily for a
        total of 400mg a day)

References:
1
 Rybix® package insert is available at: < http://www.rybixodt.com/im/rybixodt_pi.pdf >
